alt_text: Practice chart titled Shorthand: six compound-sign groups. Each row shows a letter group, a stroke drawn on a grey baseline, and a description: KW large hook with a light K; GW large hook with a heavy G; MP/MB a heavy arch for M; LR a heavy downward curve for L; RR a heavy downward curve for R; WH a large hook with a rising W stroke. A footer says these are not complete word outlines and that the drawing is new for this lesson.
